Care & maintenance tips for home furnishing items
IKEA home textiles are made for real life, messy mornings, cozy evenings, and everything in between. With just a bit of care, they’ll stay looking good for years to come. Here are the top care
With just a bit of care, they’ll stay looking good for years to come. Here are the top care maintenance tips you can follow:
Wash similar colours together to keep everything fresh and vibrant. It’s a simple step that makes a big difference.
Choose gentle detergents, especially if you have sensitive skin or are washing baby items. Less harsh = more comfort.
Iron cotton fabrics at the recommended temperature to keep them smooth and neat without damaging the fibers.
Let rugs, cushions, and throws air out regularly. A bit of fresh air helps reduce dust and keeps them feeling clean.
Always check the care label. It has all the best advice, like the right wash temperature or if tumble drying is a go.
IKEA textiles are designed to last and to live with you. With just a few thoughtful habits, you can help them stay as soft, functional, and beautiful as the day you brought them home.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What types of home textiles can I find at IKEA?
At IKEA, you’ll discover a full range of textiles—from cozy bed linens and comfy rugs to shower towels, kitchen cloths, and even fun prints for kids and babies.

Are IKEA curtains and linens machine washable?
Yes, most are! Every product clearly states whether it’s safe to toss in the washing machine, so laundry is worry-free.

Do you offer matching cushion covers and curtains?
Some styles come in coordinated colors and prints, but you won’t find exact “sets” too often. It’s more about mix, match, and make it your own.

Can I find sustainable or organic textile options at IKEA?
Yes, our products are resource and energy-efficient to empower and inspire people to live more sustainable lives.

How do I choose the right size for bedsheets or curtains?
Simply check the size chart listed on each product’s page—length, width, and all—so you know exactly what fits your bed or window.

Do bath textiles come in sets or are they sold individually?
They come one by one—whether you need just a towel, a bath mat, or a plush robe, you can grab exactly what you're after

What’s the best way to care for IKEA’s fabric products?
Follow the care tag, most items are machine-washable. Some gentle-weave fabrics prefer air drying or a low-heat tumble dry.

Can I return textiles if the color or fit isn’t right?
Yes, as long as the item is unused, clean, and in its original packaging, IKEA accepts returns according to our policy.

Are IKEA textiles child- and pet-friendly?
Definitely. Many of our textiles are soft, sturdy, and safe for families as well as perfect for playrooms, nurseries, or homes with pets.
